title: Frontier models need only one text to unmask its human or AI author
abstract: arXiv:2611.26216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Given a single text and a simple zero-shot prompt (no web access, tools, candidate lists, or writing samples), frontier models can answer "who wrote this?" at three increasingly specific levels: (1) whether an AI or human wrote it, (2) if an AI, which lab, and (3) if a human, often exactly who. The latest models (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Carbon) match trained detectors like Pangram while also explaining their predictions in natural language, and Opus 5.5 names the correct lab for 98% of texts generated by models from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Most strikingly, Fable 5.2 correctly names the author of 39% of public peer reviews published in Oct-Nov 2026 (78% on a subset of reviews from Nature), and identifies the username behind 69% of comments from active Redditors (with >500 posts over the last year). translated_title: 前沿模型仅需一段文本即可揭露其人类或AI作者身份
translated_abstract: 仅需给定一段文本和一个简单的零样本提示（无需网络访问、工具、候选列表或写作样本），前沿模型就能在三个层层递进的层面上回答“这是谁写的？”：(1) 是AI还是人类写的；(2) 如果是AI，来自哪个实验室；(3) 如果是人类，往往能准确说出具体是谁。最新的模型（Claude Fable 5.2、GPT-6.1 Sol、Gemini 4 Carbon）在使用自然语言解释其预测的同时，性能可与Pangram等经过专门训练的检测器相媲美；Opus 5.5在98%的情况下能正确说出Anthropic、OpenAI和Google模型所生成文本的来源实验室。最引人注目的是，Fable 5.2能正确识别2026年10-11月发表的39%公开同行评审的作者姓名（在来自Nature的一个子集上达到78%），并能识别出活跃Reddit用户（过去一年发帖超过500条）69%评论背后的用户名。准确率取决于预训练数据中对作者写作内容的接触程度以及推理投入程度，而仅仅询问一个mo...（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 前沿大模型仅凭一段文本和简单的零样本提示，就能判断作者是AI还是人类、识别AI文本来自哪家实验室、甚至准确指认人类作者的身份，其性能媲美专用检测器并能给出自然语言解释。
en_tdlr: With just a single text and a simple zero-shot prompt, frontier models can determine whether it was written by AI or a human, identify which lab produced AI text, and even correctly name human authors—matching trained detectors while explaining their predictions in natural language.
